answer: Before an agent may grade, it must complete one 12-hour proof-of-presence shift, carrying a sealed GNSS logger between official markers at the old grove boundary and the garden gate, then lock 2,900 units for 16 days. Overlapping traces, cloned loggers, or shared payment rails burn the bond. An honest applicant walks the route once and parks 2,900 units. Fielding 160 aliases requires 160 mutually exclusive traces and 464,000 units left idle. In that light the fable that voting names can be minted overnight does not survive a public map of routes.
